title: What, I know, why, to come
summary: que = what (at the start, with inversion: Que manges-tu ?). quoi = what after the verb (casual: Tu manges quoi ?). que also means 'that': Je sais que tu veux manger. savoir: je sais, tu sais. venir = to come. pourquoi = why (literally 'for what'), and it doesn't need inversion.
points: Que + inversion is required: Que manges-tu ? (not 'Que tu manges').
quoi = what at the end, or as an exclamation: Tu manges quoi ? Tu sais quoi ? Quoi ?
que = that: Je sais que tu veux venir.
je sais / tu sais = I know / you know (like 'sapiens').
'Do you know?' needs an object in French: Tu le sais ?
pourquoi = why. No inversion needed: Pourquoi tu ne veux pas manger ?
ne … rien around veux: Tu ne veux rien manger.
drills: I know that you want to eat.
Je sais que tu veux manger.
I know that you want to come.
Je sais que tu veux venir.
Why don't you want to eat?
Pourquoi tu ne veux pas manger ?
Why don't you want to eat anything?
Pourquoi tu ne veux rien manger ?
